A wonderful opportunity for some excellent local food!
Nov 2025 • Couples
I came here for lunch. The owner and staff were wonderful, very friendly and welcoming. Their meal recommendations were delicious and portions were very appropriate. I enjoyed my lunch so much I found myself coming back that evening for dinner. My eyes were bigger than my stomach, but the baba ganoush, garlic butter fish and morning glory vegetables were too tasty to pass up. I believe that this has been the tastiest day of my four week stay here in-country. Highly recommend for others to experience the staff and food if the opportunity presents itself!

p.s. the flan with caramel coffee sauce was excellent, although I understand based on partner input that the chocolate moose was just as yummy!

The staff were very friendly don’t and accommodating and even asked if we needed a lift back to the hotel one evening when it was raining. Their English is also very good,

Food - well everything I tried was cooked to perfection and was so very tasty. Travelling with two who are both quite as adventurous there as still plenty to choose including burger and fries. 2 cokes, 2 beers, half a bottle of local wine and 3 main courses around £18-£20.
